title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
description: Configuration variables for Oracle Cloud Infrastructure CLI (oci) and compute/network cloud driver

OCI_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install oci. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

OCI_VERSION.description: Specific version of oci to install.

OCI_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading oci binary or archive artifacts.

OCI_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying oci available remote releases.

OCI_REGION.description: Default Oracle Cloud Infrastructure region identifier (e.g., us-ashburn-1).

OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID.description: Default OCI compartment OCID for VCN, security list, and compute instance provisioning.

OCI_SUBNET_ID.description: Default OCI subnet OCID attached to provisioned compute instances.

OCI_AVAILABILITY_DOMAIN.description: Target OCI availability domain (e.g., Uocm:PHX-AD-1) for compute instances.
